source.scope: Public homepage and noindex composition comparison; other learning/Studio compositions retain established authority.
source.ramps: No synthetic tonal ramps: retain existing five selectable accent presets and semantic theme mappings.
source.refinement: 14px metadata, 16px body, 44px maximum platform heading, 32px maximum course title. Static appearance utility row. Mobile action before artwork.
source.composition: Short platform introduction, unboxed actual course spread, program action and first three canonical lesson titles.

narrative.overview: A quiet educational platform entry leads directly into real course programs. No decorative dashboard or fabricated inventory.
keyCharacteristics: Original shared logo and Onest Cyrillic.
Open actual course spreads and canonical syllabus preview.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Use existing active semantic action, text-accent and focus tokens; no independent Radix palette in the homepage.

rules.name: The One Font Rule
rules.body: Keep display and body typography on the existing Onest stack; reserve the mono stack for code.

dos: Do preserve the existing semantic theme and accent mappings, including all five accents.
Do keep Onest, Cyrillic wrapping, visible focus and reduced-motion behaviour.
Do reuse reviewed course artwork through the web-owned resolver and its provenance record.
donts: Do not fabricate inventory, outcomes, ratings or continuation.
Do not make account entry a prerequisite to public material.
Do not introduce blur, autoplay or a fixed appearance layer over content.
